name: LITTLEPROUD, the Hon. David Kelly

headline.note: Official parliamentary records establish cotton chipping in 1993 and banking/finance from 1994 to 2016. Employer and industry sources divide the banking career between NAB and Suncorp and identify senior agribusiness roles, while parliamentary interests and first-person statements establish a Warwick rental business. None of the sources publishes full-time status, exact payroll boundaries, leave or the relationship between business ownership and operational work. Party positions and elected office are excluded. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography and 2017 Parliamentary Handbook record cotton chipping in 1993. Employer, location, seasonal dates, hours and continuity are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A year label for seasonal agricultural labour does not establish a full-time interval.

career_spells.role: Agribusiness and commercial banking roles; district manager in Warwick
career_spells.evidence_note: Official records give an overall 1994–2016 banking-and-finance interval. Employer and industry profiles report 17 years at NAB, including 12 years in Warwick as district manager for agribusiness and commercial banking, before joining Suncorp in 2011. In a May 2016 first-person interview Littleproud identifies a National Australia Bank posting in Nanango in 1995 and says he reached Warwick about 16 years earlier after postings in Miles, Charleville, St George, Stanthorpe and some work in Cunnamulla. These observations improve the location chronology but do not establish exact transfer, appointment or cessation dates, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: The long private-sector interval is well supported, but full-time status and exact boundaries are not.

career_spells.role: Executive Manager, Business and Agribusiness Banking, South West Queensland
career_spells.evidence_note: Industry and event biographies report that Littleproud joined Suncorp in 2011 as executive manager for South West Queensland. A contemporary 14 May 2016 interview identifies him as still Suncorp Bank's regional manager for business and agribusiness in south-west Queensland, providing a late employment observation during his candidacy. Official records place the end of his banking-and-finance career in 2016, and an industry report says he left banking after winning preselection/election. Exact commencement, cessation, hours, leave and campaign arrangements are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title does not by itself establish continuous full-time service, and the election transition is only year-bounded.

career_spells.employer: Mr Rental Southern Downs Pty Ltd trading as Mr Rentals Southern Downs
career_spells.evidence_note: Littleproud's official site identifies business ownership in Warwick. His 2016 interests register records a shareholding in Mr Rental Southern Downs Pty Ltd and his spouse's wage from the company. In 2017 Hansard he described himself as a former retail small-business owner, while 2018 reporting and a speech described current ownership and four employees. These sources establish ownership but leave his operational hours, commencement, cessation and overlap with banking/elected office unresolved. First speech confirms joint investment and local employees in2016, not his personal full-time operational work.
career_spells.counting_note: Ownership is not automatically substantive full-time employment; no countable operating interval is established.

career_spells.role: Chair, Maranoa Divisional Council and Southern Downs Electorate Council
career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary records list both party positions but do not supply dates, paid status, hours or overlap with business and banking work.
Official parliamentary service begins with the 2 July 2016 federal election.
Contemporaneous2011 government flood chronology and14April2011 news identify president. These are observations, not appointment/cessation boundaries; pay/hours unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

research_notes: Identify the 1993 cotton employer, seasonal dates, hours and any other early employment before NAB.
Obtain NAB appointment, role progression, transfers, full-time status, leave and cessation; confirm the 17-year and 12-year Warwick descriptions against employer records.
Obtain Suncorp's exact June 2011 appointment and 2016 cessation/campaign-leave evidence and confirm full-time status.

Establish Mr Rental Southern Downs acquisition, operational role, hours and cessation separately from share ownership and spouse employment; reconcile 'former' 2017 language with 2018 ownership statements.
Resolve dates, paid status and overlap for the two LNP council chair positions.

2026-10-02 follow-up: first speech and historical government flood records reviewed; omitted Warwick Chamber presidency added. No FT basis found for bank titles. FarmOnline15June2011 appointment article redirected to inaccessible tollbit endpoint:500 non-retryable; no bypass attempted. Warwick23October2015 preselection article403; Allora7April2011PDF400timeout. These source gaps did not block other research. June2011 publication date cannot establish exact appointment date; retained year boundaries. Mr Rental franchisee material concerns spouse, not proof of his operational hours. Cotton employer, NAB/Suncorp payroll and bank/business overlaps remain follow-up needs.

2026-10-03 follow-up: a contemporary 14May2016 candidate interview provides a 1995 NAB Nanango observation, Littleproud's first-person regional posting sequence and an approximately 2000 move to Warwick, plus a late observation of current Suncorp regional-manager employment during candidacy. Relative timing is not converted into exact transfer or payroll boundaries. Hours, leave, campaign arrangements, cotton employer and business-operation overlap remain unresolved.

2026-10-04 follow-up: targeted Suncorp appointment, late-2016 cessation, NAB transfer, cotton-employer and Mr Rental searches repeated the existing year-level chronology and 14 May 2016 Suncorp observation. A Treasury biography's statement that he had owned a Warwick small business and forged an agribusiness career over the preceding 20 years is too aggregated to establish a business commencement or continuous operating interval. No employer record established hours, leave, exact payroll boundaries, campaign arrangements or personal operating work at the rental company; no career field changed.
